description: Student archetypes for the behaviour engine, derived locally by scripts/calibrate-behavior.mjs from rule-based shares per roster cohort. Each student gets one persona, stable per student (hash of the id). Personas modulate the day builder’s own stable habits (how likely a student is to be a breakfast, gym, library, outing, off-campus-meal or river regular) plus a few timing shifts; shares are rebalanced per cohort (meanPreserving) so cohort averages stay calibrated.

personas.label: Typical
personas.description: Follows the day’s habits; absorbs the rest of each cohort’s regulars.

personas.label: Early riser
personas.description: A breakfast regular, everything about 45 minutes earlier, often runs the river path, rarely studies late.

provenance.note: Chronotype spread among students (morning types are a minority); sizes are assumptions.

personas.label: Night owl
personas.description: Rarely eats breakfast, starts about an hour later, an outing regular, studies in the evening.

provenance.note: Evening chronotypes are common among undergraduates; sizes are assumptions.

personas.label: Library regular
personas.description: Almost always a library regular; fewer outings and less time on the grass.

provenance.note: A minority of students account for most library hours; sizes are assumptions.

personas.label: Gym regular
personas.description: Almost always a gym regular and often a river-path runner.

provenance.note: FitRec counts entries, so regulars make up much of the measured total; sizes are assumptions.

personas.label: Varsity athlete
personas.description: Early training every day, a river-path runner, longer meals, few nights out.

provenance.note: BU fields about two dozen varsity teams (a few percent of undergraduates); training times and shares are assumptions.

personas.label: Commuting graduate student
personas.description: Comes in for class, studies in the evening, few other visits.

provenance.note: Part-time graduate programmes meet largely in the evening; sizes are assumptions.
Rule-based archetypes and shares by cohort; no observed student-level data exists in the repo.
